parallel_buyer_tracks.source: SRF 5.0 participating States and UTs (Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
parallel_buyer_tracks.why: A funded, mandated, nationally scored body that must evidence the NUMBER OF STARTUPS availing institutional support. That is a venture register, and the evidence is published every January.
parallel_buyer_tracks.distinct_because: Scope is the whole state, not one campus. The incumbent is an existing portal, not a spreadsheet. The deal size is a portal contract, not a licence.
parallel_buyer_tracks.caveat: Fewer, larger, slower deals. Must never be added to the institutional funnel.
